title: Classify Consequences of Non-Compliance
prompt: For each situation, select the most accurate consequence of non-compliance.

items.label: Negative press campaign and customer churn after a breach
Damage to brand image among business partners
Remediation costs and lost revenue during downtime
Statutory obligation to notify the supervisory authority of the breach
Contract termination by a major customer
Penalties stipulated in a vendor contract
Internal disciplinary action recorded in an employee's file
Formal warning issued by the regulator
Revocation of PCI DSS certification: card processing prohibited
Revocation of the platform's operating license

explain: Reputational = image and trust; financial = money; legal = liability and statutory obligations; contractual = commitments between parties; sanction = formal penalty; loss of license = revocation of an authorization or certification.
